unit_pptx_name: Term 4 Week 2 - Grid Coordinates - Year 5-6 Maths.pptx
anchor: across the corridor, then up the stairs: (x, y), and the numbers sit on the lines

lessons.focus: Grid references name spaces; coordinates name points on the lines. Read and plot points in the first quadrant. Critical feature: across first, then up. Review: angles (Week 1).
Plot points and draw polygons from a list of coordinates; find a missing vertex. Critical feature: join the points in the order listed. Review: angles (Week 1).
Describe movement with directions and coordinates (left/right changes x, up/down changes y). Critical feature: name which number changes. Review: fractions, decimals and percentages (Term 3).

The Cartesian plane: locate points in all four quadrants with negative coordinates. Critical feature: the sign tells the direction from the origin; x still comes first. Review: fractions, decimals and percentages (Term 3).

Translate points and shapes across the four quadrants and describe the change to each coordinate. Critical feature: moving left past zero keeps subtracting. Review: understanding and operating with fractions (Term 3).
